# PokeMCP

> Pokémon Champions VGC data for players and AI assistants: the VGC Teambuilder connector (a read-only MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants), monthly meta reports, per-Pokémon usage trends and tournament results.

## VGC Teambuilder connector

- [Connect VGC Teambuilder](https://docs.pokemcp.com/getting-started): add the MCP server at https://api.pokemcp.com/mcp to an assistant as a custom connector — no account needed
- [Tool reference](https://docs.pokemcp.com/tools): usage rankings, how a Pokémon is built, teammates, checks and counters, team legality, defensive type analysis, usage trends, and damage and Speed calculations
- [Regulations and data](https://docs.pokemcp.com/formats): which Pokémon Champions regulations are covered and how current the data is

## Meta Reports

- [Meta reports index](https://www.pokemcp.com/reports): monthly written meta reports with usage tables, month-over-month trends, and analysis grounded in Smogon ladder data
- [Pokémon Champions meta report (latest)](https://www.pokemcp.com/reports/champions): the current Champions VGC regulation — usage stats, risers/fallers, regulation changeover analysis

## Tournament results

- [Recent Pokémon Champions events](https://www.pokemcp.com/): completed public events with published top-cut teams, sourced from Limitless

## Data

- Usage statistics are weighted Pokémon Showdown ladder data published monthly by Smogon (smogon.com/stats), refreshed monthly
- The connector covers Pokémon Champions regulations (VGC doubles); meta reports also cover Smogon Gen 9 OU
- PokeMCP is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company
